text:
HackerRank has introduced Chakra, an AI interviewer agent that evaluates developer candidates by observing how they work through real-world code tasks alongside an AI assistant.

• The startup reports that Chakra conducted over 500,000 interviews during a six-month beta test with companies like Snowflake and Capgemini.
• The tool is designed to measure critical thinking, problem framing, and AI fluency instead of just checking final code output.
• HackerRank states that suspicious-activity flags were 70% to 80% lower in these AI-assisted sessions compared to traditional assessments.

Hiring processes are shifting toward evaluating how developers collaborate with AI tools and articulate their technical judgment rather than relying solely on traditional take-home tests.

Practice solving a small coding challenge while actively documenting your intermediate decisions and prompt strategies in a text file, then review your notes to ensure you can explain why you chose your specific approach.

Source: TechCrunch
